question: Among the following cities, which is closest to the Prime Meridian?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ahmedabad​**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Prime Meridian is the 0° longitude line that passes through Greenwich, London, and is used as the reference point for global longitude measurements.
 
• Among the cities listed, Ahmedabad is geographically the closest to the Prime Meridian.
 
• Ahmedabad – ~72.6° E is actually closer to 0° longitude.
 
• Ahmedabad (72.6° E) is the closest to the Prime Meridian among the given cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prime Meridian:** The Prime Meridian is the starting point for measuring longitude and divides the Earth into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres.
 
• **Longitude:** Longitude lines run vertically around the globe and are measured in degrees east or west of the Prime Meridian.
 
• **Geographical Proximity:** When determining proximity to the Prime Meridian, cities with smaller absolute longitudes are closer, regardless of their latitude.
 
• **Indian Cities:** Indian cities like Delhi, Ahmedabad, and Kanyakumari are in the Eastern Hemisphere, with longitudes greater than 0°.
 
• **Significance of the Prime Meridian:** It serves as the basis for Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and aids in global navigation and timekeeping systems.
